newsitem.title: USA: Advanced Viral names Hirschman CEO.
newsitem.headline: Advanced Viral names Hirschman CEO.

text.p: Advanced Viral Research Corp said Friday that it has named Shalom Hirschman president and chief executive officer.
Hirschman was previously the director of infectious diseases division at Mount Sinai school of medicine in New York.
Hirschman takes on the positions from Bernard Friedland, who remains chairman.
A spokesman for Advanced Viral, Brad Miles, said Friedland was staying on in a temporary capacity and would soon step down. Hirschman would then become president at the behest of the board, he said.
